plan.notes: University of Denver is on the quarter system (Fall/Winter/Spring); term_system=quarter. Official sample 4-year course plan from the 2025-2026 Undergraduate Bulletin Religious Studies program PDF (12 quarters). Plan states Total Credits: 186; declared total 186; term totals (Y1 16/16/16, Y2 16/14/16, Y3 16/16/16, Y4 16/16/12) reconcile exactly. Generic slots (common curriculum courses, RLGS 2000-level/Global Religions/Theory/Elective groups, second-major/minor/elective blocks, study-abroad block) encoded as choice slots exactly as the official plan lists them; no courses invented. BA requires 183 credits for the degree; religious studies major requires a minimum of 40 credits (religions core, theory, electives; course lists are advisory — consult the department advisor). Footnote 1: INTZ 2501 is required for any student who studies abroad and may be taken in any quarter within the year prior to studying abroad.
